text:
## Policy Review & Updates  
**Review Frequency:** Annual (or upon threat/regulatory change)
**Last Review:** 2026-01-15
**Next Review:** 2027-01-15  
---
name: Chunk 30/32

raw_entities.name: Policy Review and Updates Framework
raw_entities.description: A policy framework establishing the schedule and triggers for reviewing and updating banking policies. The policy mandates annual reviews or reviews triggered by material threat or regulatory changes, with documented review dates and next review scheduling.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon threat/regulatory change)

raw_entities.name: Annual Policy Review Requirement
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement that policies must be reviewed on an annual basis, or more frequently if triggered by material changes in threat landscape or regulatory requirements.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon threat/regulatory change)

raw_entities.name: Policy Review Trigger on Regulatory Change
raw_entities.description: A requirement that policies must be reviewed and updated upon occurrence of material regulatory changes, in addition to the standard annual review cycle.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon threat/regulatory change)

raw_entities.name: Policy Review Trigger on Threat Change
raw_entities.description: A requirement that policies must be reviewed and updated upon occurrence of material changes in the threat landscape, in addition to the standard annual review cycle.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon threat/regulatory change)
